acceptance_criteria.criterion: Scope provenance admission lookup to the current Issue only so unrelated Issues/provenance do not change an Issue's authority timestamp.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: _max_provenance_admission now takes planned_pairs (tuple of (provenance_id, provenance_kind)) and queries SELECT MAX(admission_time) FROM source_handling_provenance_records WHERE (provenance_id = ? AND provenance_kind = ?) OR ..., scoping admission lookup strictly to the Issue's exact provenance pairs. Verified by test_finding_1_unrelated_issue_provenance_scoping.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validate the complete Source Handling policy decision/disposition vocabulary before any provenance or authority write.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: validate_policy_body in source_handling.py serves as the canonical shared policy vocabulary authority. _validate_options in provision_source_handling_issue_authority.py and _validate_policy_payload in source_handling_persistence.py reuse validate_policy_body to validate all top-level decisions and durable dispositions before any write. Verified by parameterized test_finding_2_invalid_vocabulary_fails_closed_before_any_write covering all decision and disposition families.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Make interrupted provisioning recoverable without manually supplied --as-of.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: _existing_provenance_info inspects existing provenance records using planned (provenance_id, provenance_kind) pairs to recover known_at as on_or_after when --as-of is omitted. Fails closed if any planned provenance identity exists under an unexpected provenance_kind or carries mismatched content. Verified by test_finding_3_interrupted_provisioning_recovery, test_finding_3_mismatched_partial_state_fails_closed, and test_finding_3_partial_provenance_wrong_kind_fails_closed.

defect_families.evidence: Every derived record scope remains bound to issue_agent_document_id(authorization) (github-issue:repo#N).
Record IDs are content-addressed and verified via_expected_authority_record_id and record_provenance.
Authority known_at is clamped to max(on_or_after, max_provenance_admission) for the Issue's specific (provenance_id, provenance_kind) pairs.
validate_policy_body checks options and policy payloads before any persistent write.
Temporal bounds and vocabulary checks fail closed before database mutation.
Connector receipt freshness and write policies remain preserved.
Pre-ready hostile review recorded for candidate head against Issue #432.
Idempotency is exact-match only; mismatched partial state, wrong provenance kind, or mismatched authority state fails closed without superseding.
Vocabulary and option validation occurs prior to write transactions via shared validate_policy_body.
Interrupted provisioning recovers existing known_at bound by (provenance_id, provenance_kind) to preserve exact proof antecedents.

Provisioning does not trust caller time for admitted ordering; authority known_at is derived/clamped against persisted provenance admission state and fails closed when required temporal authority cannot be proven.
Validation and persistence remain transaction-bound through the existing Source Handling persistence path; no new split-view validation/write path is introduced by this patch.
Derived authority and provenance identities remain repository-assigned/content-addressed and issue-scoped; caller payloads cannot override or reuse logical identities across Issues.
Canonical validate_policy_body rejects unknown, absent, or incomplete decision/disposition vocabulary before any authority or provenance mutation, preserving fail-closed behavior.
The patch does not create a secondary persistence surface; existing Source Handling persistence restrictions continue to govern provenance, authority, metadata, and prepared artifact paths.

Interrupted retries recover persisted provenance known_at using exact provenance identity/kind pairs, preserving monotonic admitted ordering across restart/retry without requiring a caller-supplied timestamp.

findings.evidence: Provenance admission lookup was global across all issues; fixed by filtering WHERE (provenance_id = ? AND provenance_kind = ?) for the current issue's exact pairs.

Policy decision/disposition vocabulary was not validated before provenance writes; fixed by validate_policy_body in source_handling.py reused by _validate_options and _validate_policy_payload prior to any write.

Interrupted provisioning without --as-of could not recover or didn't check provenance_kind; fixed by recovering existing_known_at bound by exact (provenance_id, provenance_kind) pairs, failing closed on wrong kind.

Codex found that explicit invalid --as-of values could initialize SourceHandlingProvenanceAuthorityRepository before temporal validation, allowing schema/database mutation before fail-closed rejection. Resolved by delaying repository initialization on the explicit --as-of path until after future/genesis-rule/Issue-updated_at validation, while preserving early initialization only for the no---as-of recovery path. Regression test monkeypatches SourceHandlingProvenanceAuthorityRepository to raise if storage initialization occurs before explicit future --as-of rejection.

Codex found that validate_policy_body accepted unknown durable disposition categories when required governed categories were otherwise present. Resolved by rejecting any durable_dispositions category not in GOVERNED_DURABLE_CATEGORIES and additionally excluding UNKNOWN_CATEGORY from persistable policy categories. Regression coverage proves invented categories such as MADE_UP_SAFE_CATEGORY fail closed.

Codex found that non-string JSON array/object values in top-level policy decisions and durable dispositions could raise TypeError during set/dict membership instead of SourceHandlingBlockedError. Resolved by explicit isinstance(value, str) checks before membership for all top-level decisions, content dispositions, and lifecycle dispositions. Regression coverage proves list/dict values fail closed through governed SourceHandlingBlockedError paths.

Full CI found that the new unknown-category rejection invalidated a production-runtime fixture that used the non-governed sentinel UNUSED_CATEGORY to model an unused disposition. The production contract remains that unknown policy categories fail closed, while governed but payload-unused categories may exist without affecting persistence. Resolved by replacing the test fixture sentinel with the governed DIAGNOSTIC category, preserving both the Codex fix and the production semantics. Targeted and related Source Handling test suites pass.
